input.subject: [E10] G PRO PS5 Troubleshooting
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I recently purchased a Logitech G PRO Racing Wheel, but I'm having trouble installing it with my PS5. The racing wheel isn't connecting even though I have plugged in all the cables and connected the power supply. Could you please help me troubleshoot this?
